sections.heading: Find the patterns that move your business
sections.body:
Machine learning (ML) uses data and algorithms to learn from experience, so predictions improve as models see more relevant data.

Within Data & AI, we apply ML to the decisions that matter: churn and segmentation, demand forecasting, fraud and risk scoring, anomaly detection and predictive maintenance. Every model starts from a clear business question and is evaluated, governed and reviewed by people before its predictions are used.

sections.heading: Prediction, scoring and forecasting
sections.description: Machine learning: prediction, scoring & forecasting. Support decisions with patterns that teams can investigate, trust and act on.

cards.title: Customer & churn models
cards.description: Segment customers and predict churn so that retention, pricing and service teams act earlier and more precisely.

cards.title: Anomaly & threat detection
cards.description: Model expected patterns in operational and security data and highlight unusual activity for investigation, with context and human review.

cards.title: Fraud & risk scoring
cards.description: Develop scoring approaches – from fraud to loan default – that help teams assess cases consistently and decide where to investigate.

cards.title: Forecasting & simulation
cards.description: Use historical patterns to forecast demand, inventory and equipment failure. Make assumptions, uncertainty and model limitations explicit.

sections.title: Bring prediction into everyday decisions
sections.description: Start with a clear question and the data to investigate it.

sections.heading: From a use case to an operational model
sections.description: Established AI and ML delivery practices, with governance and the right controls around each decision – and accelerators such as our Predictive Analytics Suite.

cards.title: AI & ML idea to product
cards.description: Begin your AI and ML journey with a strong foundation. We help businesses identify and prioritise the right AI and ML use cases that can help them grow.

cards.title: AI & ML platform services
cards.description: Simplified deployment and operationalisation of AI and ML models in production provide great returns on investment.

cards.title: Explainable AI
cards.description: We ensure that your AI-driven decisions are accurate and consistent with reasoning and rationale behind them.

sections.heading: Evaluate carefully. Use predictions responsibly.
sections.description: Define your business objectives, collect and organise data, and analyse it to derive useful insights. Make the cost of a wrong prediction – a missed signal or a false positive – part of that discussion.

items.title: Define the decision
items.description: Agree whether the model supports detection, scoring or forecasting. Identify the user, the decision it informs and how people will review the output.

items.title: Prepare the data
items.description: Review data quality, access, labels and relevance to the business question. Separate training and evaluation data to support a meaningful assessment.

items.title: Evaluate the model
items.description: Compare results against agreed measures. Examine false positives, missed cases and the limitations of using historical patterns.

items.title: Monitor in operation
items.description: Review changes in data and model behaviour. Keep human oversight, feedback and retraining decisions within the operational process.
